bonuses.name: Mutative
bonuses.text: Any time a Torment deals a Wound, the GM gains 1 Ruin.

bonuses.name: Second Strike
bonuses.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Attack penalty by 2DN, as though it had the Dual Wield Talent (Wrath & Glory, page 133).

abilities.name: Unnatural Regeneration
abilities.text: Whenever a Torment rolls a 6 on the Wrath Die, the Torment regains 1D3 Wounds.

mobAbilities.name: Mutant Rabble
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of Mutants may include a Torment. These Mobs gain +1 bonus Icon to any Resolve Tests. This increases by +1 for each Torment in the Mob.
